question: Using differentials, estimate $(31.9)^{\frac{1}{5}}$ correct to five decimal places.
explanation:
Function and nearby value
Let $y=x^{\frac{1}{5}}$. Choose $x=32$ and $dx=-0.1$, because $31.9=32-0.1$.
Differential relation
$$dy=\frac{1}{5x^{\frac{4}{5}}}dx$$
Evaluation at $x=32
Since $32^{\frac{1}{5}}=2$,
$$32^{\frac{4}{5}}=16$$
Therefore,
$$dy=\frac{-0.1}{5(16)}=-\frac{0.1}{80}=-0.00125$$
Approximate value
$$(31.9)^{\frac{1}{5}}\approx32^{\frac{1}{5}}+dy$$
$$(31.9)^{\frac{1}{5}}\approx2-0.00125$$
Conclusion
Hence, $(31.9)^{\frac{1}{5}}\approx1.99875$.
